directions: Suppose your university is seeking studentsf opinions on the necessity of making College Chinese a compulsory course. You are now to write an essay to express your view. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
sample_essay:
Making College Chinese a compulsory course is highly necessary. To begin with, it can enhance students' language proficiency. In daily study and future work, strong Chinese skills are essential for clear communication and accurate expression. For instance, writing reports and giving presentations all require a good command of the Chinese language.

In addition, College Chinese helps students understand traditional Chinese culture. Through learning classic works, students can gain insights into the wisdom and values of our ancestors. For example, reading ancient poems can let students feel the beauty and profoundness of traditional culture.

Furthermore, learning College Chinese can cultivate students' critical thinking. Analyzing and interpreting texts in class can train students to think independently and form their own opinions.

In conclusion, making College Chinese a compulsory course is of great significance as it improves language skills, promotes cultural understanding, and develops critical thinking.
